join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set cooldown 5
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Cooldown changed to 5 seconds.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list adda test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'test' added, restricted to everyone and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test add test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "test" has been added to the list as item #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] test

clock_forward 10s

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] test

clock_forward 1s

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] test

clock_forward 5.5s

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] test
